description.zh: 指定要查询的API编号，支持输入多个，“,”分隔，最多支持100个
description.en: The IDs of the APIs that you want to query. Separate multiple API IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 API IDs can be entered.
The ID of the API group.

description.zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
description.en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时每页行数，最大值100，默认值为10
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
指定要查询的环境。

- **RELEASE**：线上
- **TEST**：测试

title.zh: 查询API签名密钥绑定情况

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向开放API的用户
- 非必填的参数，不传入则默认返回所有，分页返回
descriptions.en:
- This API is intended for API providers.

- The ApiIds parameter is optional. If this parameter is not specified, all results in the specified environment of an API group are returned.
